# Neo.mjs: Getting Started Guide

There are two main paths for starting with Neo.mjs:

1. **Building your own application (Recommended):** Scaffold a standalone workspace with `npx neo-app@latest`. Follow the **[Setup Guide](../learn/gettingstarted/Setup.md)** for the full walkthrough.
2. **Contributing to the engine (or running the repo's examples & tests):** Follow the **[Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)** — the single canonical reference for the 10-second engine setup loop, running Playwright test suites, materializing `.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`, claiming issues, and opening pull requests targeting `dev`.

For architecture overviews, guides, and tutorials, see **[Learning Resources](../learn/README.md)**.
